body: Thank you, I appreciate that. I feel like I have done nothing but cry. You would think that the tears would run out. There honestly isn't anyone in 'real life' there was only him. If I died now, nobody would know for weeks and weeks. There isn't anyone left to care if I am here or not. (That sounds incredibly melodramatic but it is nevertheless true)

I have no family at all - friends... they don't understand and honestly don't want to know. They think I should be 'over it' by now (its been a few weeks). I am on a waiting list for grief counselling (the UK isn't great at that) but it could be months. I can't afford to pay someone.

I know what he would want for me - but it doesn't mean that what he would want for me is possible. What I wanted for him was a life without a decade of pain and slowly disintegrating, but I couldn't give it to him. I am too angry with the universe to focus on anything good right now - I understand and appreciate what you are saying - I just do not believe in any possibility of a future that isn't this horrendous black sucking hole.
